Title: Azure Functions with Common Data Service

Body.Content:
Azure Functions templates for the Common Data Service (CDS) will be a powerful way to combine data and actions across services and applications, extending the functionality of your PowerApps. The Common Data Service is a Microsoft Azure-based service that will enable app creators to easily build new applications or extend their existing applications. Using Azure Functions means taking full advantage of serverless architecture features like dynamic scaling, paying only for usage, and easy management and development. By combining the best of all worlds with Azure, the Common Data Service, and PowerApps, professional developers will be able to expand the capability and logic to meet your needs. 

Learn more about Azure Functions templates for the Common Data Service.
